title: The Rummage Sale Hats
story: Hattie Pruitt's spring rummage sale runs on lists: a list of tables, a list of volunteers, and a list of her other lists. So when three hats turned up in the donation box without a single donor slip, the clipboard came out at once. Every donor gets a handwritten thank-you card, and Hattie does not guess. Who gave which hat?

texts: The sou'wester's donor is either Pearl or Linus.

trace.text: Clue 2 says directly that Pearl goes with the beret.
Clue 1 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Otis must go with the straw hat: clue 1 rules out the sou'wester; the beret already goes with Pearl.
Linus must go with the sou'wester: the other choices are already taken.
